rationale: Plausible, mechanistically relevant approach but critical experimental evidence is missing: assay sensitivity/LOQ and specificity on low-biomass capture-eluted fractions are unproven; signals may derive from co-isolated lipid complexes or be interfered with by buffers/excipients; LC-MS confirmation and within‑lot correlation with loss of capture-protection and in vivo recoverability (including larger-animal bridging) are required before this can be advanced to operational testing or used as a gating attribute.
